scripts.build: npm run game-data && npm run build -w @portfolio/site && npm run build -w @portfolio/admin
scripts.build:api: npm run game-data && cd apps/api && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../../dist/portfolio-api .
scripts.test:api: npm run game-data && cd apps/api && go test ./...
scripts.build:preview: npm run game-data && npm run build:preview -w @portfolio/site
